note: prop_stay_overall, mean_residence_time_low and mean_residence_time_high were removed in v1.3. Level 2 scores exceeding the human mean as better, but under the marginal value theorem staying longer is better only up to the optimum, so those three rewarded over-harvesting: agents that almost never left a patch scored highest on them. Performance is scored by total_reward and mvt_optimal_match_rate; whether residence tracks travel cost as in people is tested at Level 3 (travel_cost_residence_effect). The source-study stay rate remains in scoring/human_baselines/effort_foraging.json for reference.

metrics.name: total_reward
metrics.description: Sum of harvest_reward across all decisions. Random foraging averages around the per-stay mean (~50) times the prop-stay (~0.5) times n_trials. MVT-following humans should substantially exceed this.

metrics.name: mvt_optimal_match_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of decisions matching the per-trial MVT-optimal prediction (stay if current_reward >= running average, else leave). Random foraging is at chance (~0.5).
